data.raw_text:
President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. leads the inspection of the newly opened CAVITEX–C5 Link Segment 3B in Parañaque City on Monday, March 30.

The two-kilometer connector road is expected to significantly ease traffic flow, cutting travel time between Taguig and Parañaque from approximately one and a half hours to just 15 minutes.

The President was joined by DOTr Secretary Giovanni Lopez, DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon, MPTC President Gilbert Santamaria, MPTC President Emeritus Jose Maria Lim, Philippine Reclamation Authority Chairman Alex Lopez, and DOTr Undersecretary Steve Pastor.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
